what: On a dark three stage, a photo fills the frame. Every 8s the next photo overlaps in after 1.8s over 1.4s sine.inOut, and slowly scales 1→1.1 over 14.4s. At each change a transparent icosahedron glass (refraction index 1.1 · thickness 1.6 · dispersion 1 · opacity 0→.2) turns obliquely from (50°,24°,17°) to (53°,−8°,15°) over 4.8s sine.out, refracting and dispersing the photo behind it. The first photo scales 1→1.1 over 6s, with the first change after 3s

options.cycle: Length per slide (seconds), default 8 — original mobile 6
options.fade: Length (s) of the next photo’s overlapping fade-in, default 1.4
options.delay: Time until the next photo appears after the transition starts (s), default 1.8 — original phone version 1.6
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Two or more photos to lay down (img or canvas) — they are hidden and become textures
options.fx:slide: Event sent to the element on every flip (detail.index · total · after) — use it to sync page numbers and progress lines

note: The side using three r182 loads it first as window.THREE (in the order three-pre.js → _vendor/three@0.182.0/build/three.cjs → three-post.js — see demo.html). If absent, nothing is hooked. Shaders are precompiled when attached. Drawing stops when off screen.
